idea-plugin.name: Claude Code GUI
idea-plugin.description:
A native chat GUI for Claude Code inside JetBrains IDEs — a side-panel experience similar to the official VS Code extension, instead of the terminal.

  • Chat tool window that drives the claude CLI
  • Streams assistant responses and shows tool activity (edits, commands, reads)
  • Multi-turn conversations via session resume
  • Selectable permission mode and model
  • Runs in the context of the currently open project

Requires the Claude Code CLI to be installed separately (npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code) and an active Claude subscription.

This is an independent, unofficial plugin and is not affiliated with Anthropic.
